people.name: Dothan
people.line: A place where Joseph found his brothers and was sold.

translations.web: He said, “Go and see where he is, that I may send and get him.” He was told, “Behold, he is in Dothan.”
translations.bsb: So the king said, “Go and see where he is, that I may send men to capture him.” On receiving the report, “Elisha is in Dothan,”
translations.kjv: And he said, Go and spy where he is, that I may send and fetch him. And it was told him, saying, Behold, he is in Dothan.
translations.asv: And he said, Go and see where he is, that I may send and fetch him. And it was told him, saying, Behold, he is in Dothan.
